purpose: Independent cross-check of every consequential inherited C4 claim. Records the tension, the evidence actually inspected, the verdict, and the proof ceiling. No verdict rests on lane agreement, model reputation, benchmark timing, or recency of prose.

material_contradiction_check.criteria: A material contradiction would be an unresolved conflict between governing evidence and the current record on a claim that changes a stage count, an authority basis, or a hold.
material_contradiction_check.result: No such conflict. Every tension examined (X-01 through X-18) resolved against the inspected artifact.
